CmdAngle2.description: An angle in 10^-3 degree, counter-clockwise on the sheet (doc 05 §3.2).

CmdPt2.description: A point or a displacement [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

CmdUuid.description: A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

ColourCode.description: An IEC 60757 or profile-declared company colour code, or {"foreign": code} (doc 05 §3.2).

Csa.description: A cross-section: a Dec3 string in mm², {"awg": n} or {"kcmil": Dec3} (doc 08 §4.6).

Dec3.description: A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

description:
`marker.place` (`PlaceMarker`, WP-S2.04 §5.1; FR-CON-023, FR-CON-039): places the group wire marker of several
connections of one page. One transaction: on each connection `overrides.show_marker` becomes true,
`overrides.csa` becomes `csa` when given and `overrides.colour` becomes `colours[i]` when given; then a page item
`{"wire_marker": {connections, at, angle, fields: ["csa", "colour"]}}` lists the connections in the given (printed)
order. The marker displays the connections' effective values; it stores none of its own (doc 08 §4.5). Nothing
derived is read. Rejected: no connection, or one listed twice (at `/connections`); a connection that does not
exist (not found) or is not drawn on `page` (at `/connections/<i>`); an angle other than 0 or 90000 (at
`/angle`); `colours` neither empty nor one per connection (at `/colours`); a colour that is neither an IEC 60757
code nor a company code of the project's colour profile (at `/colours/<i>`, FR-CON-019); a missing page (not
found). Interactive. Outcome: the marker.

angle.description: The angle in 10⁻³ degree: 0 or 90000; default 0.

at.description: The anchor point of the group.

colours.description: The colours to set: empty, or one per connection in order (their level-7 overrides).

connections.description: The connections in printed order: at least one, distinct, all drawn on `page`.

csa.description: A cross-section to set on every connection (its level-7 override).

title: marker.place
